meta.purpose: Every committed prediction of GPU jobs 073-098, split into its separable clauses and scored under one stated interval rule. Hand-encoded from the job-script headers on the gpu branch, the prereg/*.json statistics and the prereg/*_outcome_*.md notes. Read by scripts/scorecard.py, which writes prereg/scorecard.json and paper/tab_scorecard.tex.
meta.ci_rule: A clause is 'held' only when its point estimate is on the predicted side and its 95% paired-bootstrap interval excludes the threshold (for a band, lies entirely inside it); a clause whose point estimate is on the predicted side but whose interval includes the threshold, or for which no interval exists, is 'held (point)'; a clause whose point estimate is on the wrong side is 'failed'; 'untested' means the clause could not be evaluated; 'void' means the job was voided. Deterministic clauses (tables, counts of problems, whether a run completed) have no interval and are held or failed outright.

types.sign: a direction only: A ahead of / beats / leads B (threshold 1 on a ratio of means)
types.threshold: a numeric bar other than a bare direction: >= 1.8x, >= 5%, <= 0.25 ms, >= 8 of 10
types.band: an interval: within +-5%, within -3 to +10%, 120-190 tok/s
types.equality: a deterministic or structural outcome: identical text, a table's entries, a run completing

meta.supplementary_intervals: Where a prereg JSON has no interval for a clause, one was computed for this scorecard from the job's raw rows (results/<job>/bs1.jsonl) with scripts/samehost_stats.boot_ratio (paired by problem, 10,000 resamples, seed 0) or the same bootstrap of a single mean; the source field says so.
meta.paper_log_field: paper_log is the status the paper's prediction log (paper/app_wsg.tex, one line per prediction) gives the prediction the clause belongs to.
